explanation.headline: Hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen is not on FDA's shortage list today; Corvale Lakeside has 12 days on hand while Corvale East and General have 17 and 29 days

sentences.text: Corvale Lakeside holds 59 units at 4.8 units per day, giving 12 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 263 units at 15.7 units per day, giving 17 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 558 units at 19.4 units per day, giving 29 days on hand.
The product label identifies Proficient Rx LP as the repackager with FEI 3011557028, last inspected 2022-12-08 with a VAI classification.
FDA inspection records for that FEI show VAI classifications on 2015-10-22 and 2022-12-08.

rejected.text: FDA's shortage list does not include hydrocodone bitartrate and acetaminophen as of 2026-10-21.
Check current allocation limits with A-S Medication Solutions and verify if other sites can transfer stock to Lakeside.

Q-372b5a.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-2c3dcc.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('199d4915-cb3b-48f3-835d-a45d04a5c940') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-bbcd66.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-252e40.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-c51927.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-f8bf22.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3011557028', '3005117563', '2245277', '3004161147', '1510437', '1021320') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-f6cbe9.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3011557028', '3005117563', '2245277', '3004161147', '1510437', '1021320') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-2ac723.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3011557028') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('proficient rx')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-676386.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('proficient rx') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%hydrocodone%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-29148c.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('63187077812')

Q-5ba096.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%hydrocodone%'
